plugins.name: claude-code-desktop-sync
plugins.description: Two-way syncs stdio MCP servers between Claude Code and Claude Desktop at session start, rewriting launchers like npx to absolute paths for Desktop. HTTP or header-auth servers that cannot live in Desktop's config are reported with the exact manual step. One-sided changes propagate; conflicts are held and reported, never overwritten. Backs up before writing; a bundled skill offers on-demand sync.

plugins.name: no-hidden-changes
plugins.description: 👁️ Steers Claude toward visible, honest, reversible changes instead of hidden-state workarounds: edit the source rather than a derived copy, branch and stage by path, never rewrite published history, bump versions when you publish, and record any automation you install. A first-run pass checks the rule against your existing memories and instructions and surfaces conflicts for you to decide.

plugins.name: summon-skills
plugins.description: 💡 Makes Claude actually use the skills you already have: a local matcher names the 1–3 installed skills that fit each prompt (process skills first, each at most once per session), with zero model calls or network requests. At session start it also flags installed plugins that are inert because a command or environment variable they need is missing, with the install command where known.

plugins.name: check-code
plugins.description: 🩻🔬 After each edit, checks just the lines Claude changed for bugs, style slips and risky patterns, using the code-checking tools you already have (ruff, shellcheck, biome and more), and hands any problems straight back so they get fixed in the same turn. Your repo's own settings are respected, an edit is never blocked, and a clean edit costs nothing. Five built-in checks need no tools at all.

plugins.name: measure-twice
plugins.description: ⚖️ Before building automation, surveys the hooks, cron jobs, launch agents, scripts and notes you already have, so it extends what exists instead of duplicating it, then matches the trigger to the real event — a SessionStart hook, a scheduled job, a watcher or a loop — so the machinery fires when it actually matters. A zero-cost skill plus a stateless SessionStart reminder.

plugins.name: resume-interrupted
plugins.description: ⚡️ Detects when your most recent session in a project was cut off mid-task — a crash, a dropped connection or a usage limit — and offers at startup to pick up where you left off. It never offers a session that is still running, tells you whether a limit that stopped you has reset, and recovers the context from the transcript. The `interrupted` command lists and reviews unfinished sessions.

plugins.name: mcp-smoke-test
plugins.description: 🔌 Onboard and verify any MCP server that drives an external app: a repeatable read-only smoke test with actionable failure hints, a capability probe that gives each tool a WORKS / PARTIAL / BROKEN / INCONCLUSIVE verdict from assertions that can fail, an evidence-based capabilities manual, and an interactive prerequisite-ladder setup guide, all from parametrized templates.

plugins.name: waypoints
plugins.description: 🧭 Surfaces your open tasks as a SessionStart banner that persists until each item is marked done — reading an explicit store, so it shows exactly what you logged. Manage items by just asking Claude or via the waypoints CLI (add, edit, done, triage, pin, repo tags, search), with journal, backups, archive, and corrupt-store recovery built in. Disable anytime via /plugin.

plugins.name: audit-loose-ends
plugins.description: ✍️ Reconciles your durable records at the end of a task or session — memories, project notes, reminders, task lists and, if installed, the waypoints store — so finished work is never left flagged as to-do and nothing redundant or orphaned stays behind. A transcript scanner audits long sessions cheaply, a check confirms git hygiene and test results, and a secret scanner sweeps touched files.

plugins.name: run-to-completion
plugins.description: 🏃 Runs a queue of open work to completion unattended and ships each finished change all the way out: triage into do-now / heavy / gated, execute without stopping between items, ship through an integrated tool that merges, tags, releases and checks the installed copy, and close out with a gated list of what was left and why. Includes an autopilot orchestrator, an attended blocker-clearing pass, and the /ship and /ship-config skills for single-repo attended ships and their rtc-ship.json config.

plugins.name: get-haiggoh
plugins.description: 👨🏻‍💻 Manage, install, and update haiggoh plugins for Claude Code via direct CLI commands or an interactive menu. Preview updates with dry-run plans, filter actions by plugin name or category, and automatically create PATH shortcuts so installed plugin tools run directly from your shell. Verifies installed versions against remote repositories and manages launchers on session start.

plugins.name: brief-agents
plugins.description: 📝 Subagents inherit none of your durable rules — not your CLAUDE.md, memory or plugin nudges. brief-agents scans all three into one compact ~/.claude/agent-briefing-index.md, regenerated when the sources change. A SessionStart hook nudges you to brief subagents, and a PreToolUse hook blocks unbriefed Agent/Task code delegations (Workflow gets a soft reminder; [no-brief] opts out; forks exempt).

plugins.name: free-agents
plugins.description: 📡🦾 Run Claude Code on free inference, on two lanes: free cloud APIs (NVIDIA, Gemini and more) and local MLX models on Apple Silicon. Offload bounded sub-tasks from your paid session to a free model while your capable model keeps driving, or run whole free sessions with `csl` and `csl remote`. Includes a picker for lanes and models, role-based routing, free-tier key setup and a savings ledger.

plugins.name: cost-tracker
plugins.description: 💸 Reports Claude Code spend on three labelled axes — per-session lifetime, today across all sessions, free local-lane savings — from the statusline cost ledger. Period reports (today/week/month/since), per-day trend, category breakdowns, a statusline wrapper, learned caps and gateway fees. Calibrates daily total against the gateway's refusal figure; quarantines invalid records with diagnostics.

plugins.name: lasting-plans
plugins.description: 📜 Keeps every Claude Code plan and playbook in local, Git-versioned archives (~/Claude-plans, ~/Claude-playbooks), out of reach of the cleanup that deletes old plans. It imports existing files, watches for changes on macOS, keeps the archive copy when a source disappears, and records creation dates, Finder tags and labels. A CLI searches, shows history and restores; a remote backup is optional.

plugins.name: watch-your-step
plugins.description: 🛘🥾 A PreToolUse hook that checks each command before it runs. Silent-corruption traps — backticks in double quotes, commits with conflict markers, discarded uncommitted work, unrecoverable branch deletions — are blocked with the exact fix; risky habits like git add -A only warn. A git-level guard also refuses unrecoverable branch deletions by any route. Override a rule once: # wys:allow <rule>.
